rationale.verdict: Walked Etherscan (name-tag search + direct contract page), Mirror article (official OASF announcement), and protocol website. 5 addresses catalogued. The primary stETH deposit contract (UUPS proxy + Distribution implementation) is confirmed on Ethereum Mainnet with ~$32.5M TVL. Three privileged role addresses (owner, aoDistributionWallet, refunderAddress) require on-chain reads that could not be performed this run due to no pinned surfacer URLs; they are flagged for next-run resolution.

protocol_metadata.about: AO Bridge is the Ethereum-side pre-bridge deposit contract for the AO decentralized supercomputer built on Arweave. Users deposit stETH (Lido staked ETH) into the contract and receive AO token rewards proportional to their share of total deposited assets; the native stETH yield is forwarded to AO ecosystem development organizations via bridgeOverplus. Depositors retain full withdrawal rights over their principal at any time, while the Open Access Supercomputing Foundation (OASF) holds a single emergency-eject privilege to return tokens to their owners in a security incident. The contract is an ERC1967 UUPS proxy wrapping a Distribution logic contract derived from MorpheusAI deposit contracts.
